source_text: De magistris et discipulis sub nomine Nili Ancyrani fragmenta e codd. Paris. gr. 1188 + 1066 43 Ἄτεχνος κυβερνήτης ἕτοιμος ναυαγία καὶ ἀνεπιστήμων ἡγούμενος ἀπώλεια μαθητῶν. Ἄπειρος ποιμὴν ἐξέστρεψεν ἀστραγάλους προβάτων καὶ ἡγούμενος ὁδοὺς μαθητῶν. Οὐ διαγνώσεται ἐν ὁμίχλῃ ἀνὰ μέσον προβάτων ἀνεπιστήμων ποιμὴν οὐδ' ἐν καιρῷ πειρασμῶν ἐρεῖ τι συμφέρον διδάσκαλος ἄπειρος. Στρατηγὸς πολέμου καὶ παθῶν ἰατρός ἐστιν ἐπιστήμων ἡγούμενος· ἢ γὰρ τρωθῆναι οὐκ ἐάσει ἢ τρωθέντα ταχέως ἰάσεται. Ἀνήκοος μαθητὴς διεστραμμένον ξύλον καὶ οὐ μὴ ὀρθωθῇ ἐλεγχόμενος συνεχῶς. Ἀσύμφωνος ἀδελφὸς ἀπηχούσης λύρας νευρὰ καὶ τῇ κοινωνίᾳ λυομένη τοῦ κοινοῦ μέλους. Κηφὴν ἐσθίει μελισσῶν πόνους καὶ ῥᾴθυμος ἀδελφὸς ἐλαττοῖ συνοδίας ἐνάρετον πρᾶξιν.
thought_title: The unskilled guide destroys; the skilled guide heals
orientation: Evagrius opens the treatise by addressing the monastic leader directly, comparing unskilled and skilled guides through a series of parallel images.
pass_a_gloss: An unskilled pilot is ready shipwreck, and an ignorant leader is destruction of disciples. An inexperienced shepherd twisted the ankles of sheep, and a leader the paths of disciples. An ignorant shepherd will not discern in mist in the midst of sheep, nor will an inexperienced teacher say something beneficial in time of trials. A skilled leader is a general of war and a physician of passions; for either he will not allow one to be wounded, or he will quickly heal one who has been wounded. A disobedient disciple is a twisted piece of wood, and he will not be straightened when reproved continually. A discordant brother is a string of an out-of-tune lyre, and by his discord it is cut off from the common melody. A drone eats the labors of bees, and a careless brother diminishes the virtuous practice of the community.

pass_b_english: An unskilled pilot is a shipwreck waiting to happen, and an ignorant leader is the destruction of his disciples. An inexperienced shepherd has twisted the ankles of his sheep, and a leader twists the paths of his disciples. An ignorant shepherd will not discern among sheep in the fog, nor will an inexperienced teacher say anything useful in a time of trial. A skilled leader is a general in war and a physician of the passions: he will either keep a man from being wounded or heal him quickly once he is wounded. A disobedient disciple is a warped piece of wood, and he will never be straightened no matter how often he is reproved. A discordant brother is a string on an out-of-tune lyre, and by his discord he is cut off from the common melody. A drone eats the labors of the bees, and a careless brother diminishes the virtuous practice of the community.
